<subject>NORDWIND/GRIDLINK AVAILABILITY</subject>
<body>
To all GRIDLINK users:

The GRIDLINK system will be brought down on a nightly basis between 00:01 - 04:00 CET for nightly processing. The system will be available in the morning after that time, with grid schedules primed by 05:30.

NetzMonitor will be available during these times.

Please call the GRIDLINK Hotline (+49 171 373 5700) if you have any questions or concerns.
</body>
